title: TE Mason Taylor sees "endless opportunities" in Jets offense

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: TE Mason Taylor sees "endless opportunities" in Jets offense
sources.description: The Jets drafted tight end Mason Taylor in the second round in 2025, so some might wonder how well he took the news that they used a first-round pick on a player at the same position this year.
